sources.title: Minerals
sources.role: Planning guidance for mineral safeguarding, extraction, supply, restoration and aftercare.
sources.facts: A safeguarded resource or landbank is not a presumption that minerals will be worked and does not grant permission or permits.
sources.guard: Mineral, coalfield, stability, radon and aggregate records do not by themselves prove an exact hazard, viable reserve, permission, licence, remediation or development suitability.

sources.title: National Planning Policy Framework - Facilitating the sustainable use of minerals
sources.role: National policy for mineral safeguarding and steady supply.
sources.facts: Mineral Safeguarding Areas and aggregate assessments are strategic policy evidence, not exact reserve quality or extraction approval.
sources.guard: Mineral, coalfield, stability, radon and aggregate records do not by themselves prove an exact hazard, viable reserve, permission, licence, remediation or development suitability.

sources.title: Planning applications and Coal Mining Risk Assessments
sources.role: Official requirements and advice for development in coalfield risk areas.
sources.facts: Interactive risk-area screening is indicative; exact mine entries, ground conditions and mitigation require site investigation and authority review.
sources.guard: Mineral, coalfield, stability, radon and aggregate records do not by themselves prove an exact hazard, viable reserve, permission, licence, remediation or development suitability.

sources.title: Planning advice service for developing on the coalfield
sources.role: Current official pre-application service for Development High Risk Areas.
sources.facts: Submitting or receiving advice does not constitute planning permission, a risk clearance or remediation acceptance.
sources.guard: Mineral, coalfield, stability, radon and aggregate records do not by themselves prove an exact hazard, viable reserve, permission, licence, remediation or development suitability.

sources.title: Land stability
sources.role: Planning guidance on natural and mining-related land instability.
sources.facts: Strategic instability information is not a qualified site assessment or confirmation that land is safe and stable.
sources.guard: Mineral, coalfield, stability, radon and aggregate records do not by themselves prove an exact hazard, viable reserve, permission, licence, remediation or development suitability.

sources.title: Radon
sources.role: UKHSA radon guidance, research and affected-area resources.
sources.facts: Affected-area maps are screening resources and do not replace property measurement or building-specific protective design.
sources.guard: Mineral, coalfield, stability, radon and aggregate records do not by themselves prove an exact hazard, viable reserve, permission, licence, remediation or development suitability.

sources.title: UK National Radon Action Plan
sources.role: National strategy for managing radon exposure in homes and workplaces.
sources.facts: National arrangements do not establish the radon level or mitigation requirement for an individual parcel or building.
sources.guard: Mineral, coalfield, stability, radon and aggregate records do not by themselves prove an exact hazard, viable reserve, permission, licence, remediation or development suitability.

sources.title: Aggregate minerals survey for Great Britain, 2023
sources.role: Official survey of aggregate sales, flows, consumption, reserves and planning activity.
sources.facts: Regional and national survey totals do not prove current site reserves, commercial viability or planning status.
